newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks edge up on gain by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks edge up on gain by blue chips.

text.p: Gains by some blue chips in active trading pushed the Dhaka Stcok Exchange index 1.15 percent higher on Thursday ahead of the weekend, brokers said.
The DSE all-share price index closed 21.19 points or 1.15 percent up at 1,847.77 on a turnover of 91.3 million taka. Of 96 traded issues 56 gained, five were unchanged and 35 lost.

"The retail investors were particularly attracted to (leading shares) which helped the index move up," one broker said. United Leasing Company gained 213 taka to 2,800, Apex Foods rose 17 to 4,407 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals was up 5.0 to 208.
